description: Unit tests for the CTLogVerifier class, including verification of Merkle tree proofs, consistency proofs, and SCT verification, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierTest
classes.description: Test fixture for CTLogVerifier, setting up a verifier instance and utility functions for proof verification.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierConsistencyProofTest
classes.description: Parameterized test for verifying correctness of consistency proofs.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierAuditProofTest
classes.description: Parameterized test for verifying correctness of audit proofs.

classes.name: CTLogVerifierTestUsingGenerator
classes.description: Test fixture for generating Merkle trees and proofs for various sizes to test proof verification.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the log verifier instance before each test.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Constructs proof vectors from test data.

methods.name: VerifyConsistencyProof
methods.description: Verifies a Merkle consistency proof between two tree states.

methods.name: VerifyAuditProof
methods.description: Verifies a Merkle audit proof for a leaf.

methods.name: CheckVerifyAuditProof
methods.description: Checks that an audit proof verifies correctly and invalid proofs fail.

methods.name: CheckVerifyConsistencyProof
methods.description: Checks that a consistency proof verifies correctly and invalid proofs fail.
